text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
F-Fight for the Ro clan?
What is the meaning of this?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
My words are unambiguous in their
meaning. 
… Members of the Ro clan, hear me! 
I direct this at your highest of rank!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I offer thee the following!
Take me into the Ro clan, 
and I shall guide you to the I clan's
banner!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huuuh!?

text_block_list.name: [Ro Clan] Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
W-What are you saying!?
Did you not understand the rules? 
You still can't win by doing this…!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I can't. However,
what if I told thee that I was willing to
lose? 
A victory at a Fan Fest game? Take it,
'twill not bother me. Instead…

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I wish to enjoy my fill of the
scrumptious-looking food back 
at the academy's stalls～♪ 'Tis, after all,
a grand festival, 
and a grand feast!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wha…! What…!? Truly,
what has gotten into you!!?

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
What's going on?
Are they having an argument? 
It seems that we are witnessing internal
strife… 
What could have happened……?

text_block_list.name: [Ro Clan] Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you serious?
You're really going to switch sides…!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Come, come, follow me now～♪ 
Shouldst thou idle here,
I shall leave thee behind～

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, wait! This is a joke, right?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Stop right there!
Your tomfoolery has gone far enough. 
I cannot let you go!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Step aside, Yaeno ——
(Slash!)

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
W-What did we just witness!? Friendly fire,
and not accidental 
by the looks of it!
Just where is this leading!?

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
General Yaeno Muteki has taken her second
hit, 
leaving her with only one more life!

text_block_list.name: [Ro Clan] Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
This girl… she actually did it…! 
It appears she seriously wants to join our
side.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Farewell, my compatriots.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
……! After them! We must get to our banner 
before they do and defend it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —— Hwaaaah～ That was a close one～ We just got here in time and fended them off…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: No Reason… There must be some kind of misunderstanding… No… you can never tell with her. Hmmm, hmmmmm…!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Uuugh… ghuuuh…!

text_block_list.name: [I Clan] Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
I really misjudged No Reason…! 
I can't believe that she's someone 
who would do something like this!

text_block_list.name: [I Clan] Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
She was fighting for us so desperately at
the bridge! 
What do we do?
Without her we're really not going to win…

text_block_list.name: [I Clan] Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
We lost a lot of infantry in the fight just
now. Our general's 
also down to her last life.
I don't see how we can recover 
from this anymore……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps… I have been too imprudent.
I thought that I did 
everything I could,
and left matters to fate. Yet…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That's not… You weren't the only… 
Never mind……

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Taishin… Hey, Yaeno, please recall 
our victory against the Ha clan.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain… it wasn't because we all just
"did our best". 
We won because we took that decisive first
step, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: [I Clan] Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
True… we turned that situation around because
everyone 
was on board with the plan we made.
If we had waited for our opponent's move,
we couldn't have pulled that off.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Aaah… I think I somewhat understand? Simply doing our best isn't enough to close the difference.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
They're working as hard as we are on the
other team. Therefore,
we have to take that first step before they
do… 
or something like that?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(They're right… effort and perseverance are
important. 
But perhaps I forgot to reach for something
beyond that.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(I have been slacking off in some respects,
have I not? 
Without realising, I had become complacent,
satisfied 
with only "doing my best"……)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (… Little strokes fell great oaks. Perseverance will lead to strength. Those words have not led me astray. However…)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
'Twas certainly not an honorable action,
but how does mine 
compare to the unapologetic determination
she showed? 
Am I not simply aimlessly clawing at that
tree?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Our opponent is that "monster"!
One who is loved by fate 
much more than myself.
'Twas naive of me to "wait for an 
opportunity" against such an opponent…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If my mediocre self wanted to stage an
uprising, I should 
have seized the reigns much more
fiercely…!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —— Focus!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hyeeeh! Y-Yaeno…!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. I got a little fired up. 
But I have had a revelation.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Making an earnest effort is most certainly
a virtue. 
However, if one becomes complacent in this,
one will 
quickly grow stagnant.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have been… naive! Opportunities do not 
come from waiting, we must create them!
